# Rocky coordinator (david-cluster-1) — public integration info

## Trust bundle (the one artifact)
Lives at `selfhosted-platform` → `manifests/secrets/rocky-coordinator-genesis.yaml` (`data["bundle.json"]`), and in the cluster as ConfigMap `rocky-coordinator-genesis` in namespace `rocky-coordinator` (key `bundle.json`).

```json
{
  "format": 1,
  "root": "4302b557f51216062ff616dc0246f5d7bcf3f04102c7d42e9f222a5113fdebd6",
  "mesh": [82,75,123,115,236,16,26,168,49,219,79,195,227,114,235,226],
  "genesis": ""
}
```

- **Genesis id:** `98fdccbbd805cdaf280cf8af7bf3faba24a3473cd1855442f3ce641db8e87677`
- `mesh` is the 16 mesh bytes as numbers; `genesis` is the lowercase-hex CBOR that `TrustBundle::from_json` decodes and verifies against `root` and `mesh`. Hand clients only this file.
